**Nivyx v2.2.2 — cleaner Linux installation.**

- On Debian/Ubuntu, `sudo ./scripts/install.sh` now installs any missing dependencies automatically (compiler, `make`, `nftables`, OpenSSL and headers, `pkg-config`, `curl`) — a fresh machine needs nothing installed first
- Other distributions get a clear list of what to install; if package installation fails the installer stops safely and your internet is untouched
- The standalone Linux engine binary is no longer a release asset: Linux users install from the repository with the installer
- `nivyx update` on Linux works as before
- No DPI engine behavior changes

Windows and macOS packages are unchanged.
